title: REPORT on European Central Bank – annual report 2024
part_text: Text as a whole without the words: ‘climate-related or’
part_context: Welcomes the ECB’s efforts to regularly update its models; invites the ECB to continue reviewing and improving its models and their role in its policymaking in light of the subpar performance of the models in recent years, in order to learn from previous crises, particularly to better distinguish between demand-driven and supply-side sources of inflation; stresses that economic supply shocks can arise from many sources, among others geopolitical events, <del>climate-related or</del> natural disasters and cyberattacks;
